cd /workspace && python -c "
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import seaborn as sns
import seaborn.objects as so

# Create synthetic data with large values
np.random.seed(42)
n = 100
species = np.random.choice(['A', 'B', 'C'], n)
bill_length = np.random.uniform(35, 60, n)
bill_depth = np.random.uniform(15, 25, n)
body_mass_mg = np.random.uniform(1e6, 5e6, n)  # Values around 1e6

import pandas as pd
data = pd.DataFrame({
    'bill_length_mm': bill_length,
    'bill_depth_mm': bill_depth,
    'species': species,
    'body_mass_mg': body_mass_mg
})

# Test seaborn.objects.Plot with pointsize legend
plot = (
    so.Plot(
        data, x='bill_length_mm', y='bill_depth_mm',
        color='species', pointsize='body_mass_mg',
    )
    .add(so.Dot())
)

# Plot and save
plotter = plot.plot()
fig = plotter._figure

# Check the figure's legends
print('Figure legends:', fig.legends)
print()
for i, legend in enumerate(fig.legends):
    print(f'Legend {i}: {legend}')
    print(f'  Title: {legend.get_title().get_text()}')
    print(f'  Labels: {[t.get_text() for t in legend.get_texts()]}')
"
